mapperNodes.xml: <select id="selectDirectory" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P16ProjectSyncTask$Directory">SELECT id,code,name,'COMPANY' AS kind FROM system_company WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE UNION ALL SELECT id,code,name,'DEPARTMENT' AS kind FROM system_dept WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE</select>

<select id="selectAccountBindings" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P16ProjectSyncTask$AccountBinding">SELECT u.id,u.username,b.object_key AS kind,b.source_key FROM int_base_sync_binding b JOIN int_base_sync_task t ON t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.id=b.task_id AND t.task_code='BASE_P04' AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND t.deleted=FALSE JOIN int_base_sync_run run ON run.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND run.id=b.last_run_id AND run.task_id=t.id AND run.preview=FALSE AND run.status='COMPLETED' AND run.deleted=FALSE JOIN system_users u ON u.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND u.id=b.target_id AND u.deleted=FALSE WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.object_key IN ('USER_FND','USER_T') AND b.deleted=FALSE</select>

<select id="selectProjects" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P16ProjectSyncTask$Row">SELECT `id`,`project_code`,`code_root_id`,`project_sequence`,`code_rule_version`,`project_name`,`parent_id`,`root_id`,`tree_path`,`tree_depth`,`tree_sort`,`business_level_code`,`business_level_name`,`customer_id`,`customer_code`,`customer_name`,`manager_id`,`manager_employee_no`,`manager_name`,`company_id`,`company_code`,`company_name`,`department_id`,`department_code`,`department_name`,`project_type`,`signing_method`,`project_category`,`implementation_mode`,`major_project_level`,`market_code`,`market_name`,`system_code`,`system_name`,`expend_code`,`expend_name`,`industry_code`,`industry_name`,`customer_project_name`,`sales_type`,`business_type`,`service_level_code`,`not_track_reason`,`contract_no`,`implementation_location`,`location_resolution_status`,`creation_reason`,`lifecycle_template_id`,`lifecycle_template_revision_no`,`lifecycle_template_revision_id`,`template_load_method`,`process_definition_key`,`process_definition_version`,`project_start_time`,`project_refresh_time`,`project_close_time`,`source_type`,`status`,`progress`,`aggregation_weight`,`weight_source`,`version`,`creator`,`create_time`,`updater`,`update_time`,`deleted`,`deleted_time`,`tenant_id`,`lifecycle_status`,`current_stage`,`assignment_status`,`task_tree_version`,`task_progress_version`,`project_end_date`,`closure_policy_snapshot`,`closure_type`,`closed_from_stage`,`closed_at`,`active_plan_version_id`,`custom_info`,`order_create_time`,`disabled`,`effective_from`,`effective_to` <select id="selectParties" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P16ProjectSyncTask$PartyRow">SELECT `id`,`tenant_id`,`project_id`,`party_role`,`party_code`,`party_name`,`contact_name`,`phone`,`source_system`,`source_table`,`source_record_key`,`effective_from`,`effective_to`,`status`,`version`,`creator`,`create_time`,`updater`,`update_time`,`deleted` FROM proj_project_party WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND source_system='DPPMS' AND source_table='pm_project_header' AND party_role='FINAL_CUSTOMER' <choose><when test="query.keys != null and !query.keys.isEmpty()">AND source_record_key IN <foreach collection="query.keys" item="key" open="(" close=")" separator=",">#{key}</foreach></when><otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise></choose><if test="!query.preview"> FOR UPDATE</if></select>

<update id="activateTrees">UPDATE proj_project_tree_version SET status='ACTIVE',node_count=1,path_count=1,activated_at=#{context.startedAt},failed_reason=NULL,updater=#{context.actorId},update_time=#{context.startedAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{context.tenantId} AND tree_version=1 AND status='BUILDING' AND deleted=FALSE <choose><when test="rows != null and !rows.isEmpty()">AND id IN <foreach collection="rows" item="s" open="(" close=")" separator=",">#{s.treeVersionId}</foreach></when><otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise></choose></update>

<select id="oneSourcePerTargetIndex" resultType="int">SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.statistics WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='int_base_sync_binding' AND index_name='uk_int_base_sync_binding_target' AND non_unique=0</select>
<select id="selectCompanies" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P16ProjectSyncTask$Company">SELECT id,compCode AS code FROM t_company LIMIT #{limit}</select>

<select id="selectLegacyAccounts" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P16ProjectSyncTask$Account">SELECT user_id AS id,user_name AS username FROM t_user LIMIT #{limit}</select>

<select id="selectProjectMaster" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P16ProjectSyncTask$Source">SELECT p.`projectId`,p.`projectType`,p.`projectCode`,p.`projectName`,p.`projectState`,p.`isback`,p.`column001`,p.`column002`,p.`column003`,p.`column004`,p.`column005`,p.`column006`,p.`column007`,p.`column008`,p.`column009`,p.`column010`,p.`column011`,p.`column012`,p.`columno12_readonly`,p.`column013`,p.`column014`,p.`customerProjectName`,p.`salesType`,p.`majorProjectLevel`,p.`compId`,p.`createTime`,p.`createBy`,p.`updateTime`,p.`updateBy`,p.`effectiveFrom`,p.`effectiveTo`,CAST(p.disabled AS UNSIGNED) AS disabled,p.`projectStartTime`,p.`projectRefreshTime`,p.`projectCloseTime`,p.`customInfo`,p.`customConfig` FROM pm_project p JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS projectId FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) chosen ON chosen.projectId=p.projectId WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND p.projectType='10' ORDER BY p.projectId LIMIT #{limit}</select>

<select id="selectProjectAlias" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P16ProjectSyncTask$Source">SELECT p.projectId,p.projectType,p.projectCode,chosen.projectId AS canonicalProjectId FROM pm_project p JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS projectId FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) chosen ON chosen.typeKey=CAST(p.projectType AS BINARY) AND chosen.codeKey=CAST(p.projectCode AS BINARY) JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=chosen.projectId WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.projectType='10' ORDER BY p.projectId LIMIT #{limit}</select>
